title: dotScale 2015 - John Graham-Cumming - I got 10 trillion problems, but logging ain't one
summary: John Graham-Cumming of Cloudflare talks at dotScale 2015 about handling roughly 10 trillion log lines a month. The talk touches on Cloudflare's hardware, its logging stack and its use of Lua in Nginx.
why: Mostly cited as a source for details of Cloudflare's architecture, such as LuaJIT-based request inspection and request volumes.

quote.text: I discovered a moderately old video from CloudFlare hiding in there, and had a rather big TIL moment.
